openingPrayer.title: A Steady Heart
openingPrayer.body: Lord, before I read a single headline today, settle my heart in Your peace. Whatever the news holds — conflict, uncertainty, or change — remind me that You are already there, already at work, already good. Give me a spirit of discernment, not anxiety, and a heart that stays soft toward the people behind every story. Amen.

articles.headline: Regional Ceasefire Talks Extend Into Third Week
articles.summary: Mediators report incremental progress on a humanitarian corridor agreement, though a full ceasefire remains unresolved. Aid groups say the pause has already allowed medical supplies into two previously cut-off districts.

articles.headline: Coastal Nations Sign Joint Disaster-Response Pact
articles.summary: Twelve Pacific and Caribbean nations agreed to share early-warning data and emergency resources ahead of this year's storm season, following back-to-back severe seasons.

verse.text: Do not be anxious about anything, but in every situation, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God. And the peace of God, which transcends all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.
verse.reflection: Reflection: Conflict overseas can feel far away and yet heavy on the heart. This verse doesn't ask us to look away — it invites us to carry what we've read into prayer instead of worry.

articles.headline: Rural Churches Report Rising Attendance for Third Straight Year
articles.summary: A new survey finds small-town congregations growing even as denominational membership declines nationally, with pastors citing community meals and small groups as the biggest draw.

articles.headline: Faith-Based Nonprofits Expand Mental Health Partnerships
articles.summary: A growing number of churches are pairing with licensed counselors to offer free sessions, part of a broader push to treat mental health care as a ministry priority rather than an afterthought.

verse.text: The LORD is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit.
verse.reflection: Reflection: Whether it's a congregation growing or a church opening its doors to mental health care, the thread is the same — God draws near to people exactly where they're hurting.

articles.headline: New AI Safety Standards Proposed for Consumer Devices
articles.summary: A coalition of manufacturers has proposed shared testing benchmarks for AI features in home devices, aiming to get ahead of regulation with industry-wide transparency reports.

articles.headline: Rural Broadband Expansion Passes Halfway Mark
articles.summary: Federal infrastructure funding has now connected over half of its target underserved communities to high-speed internet, two years ahead of the original timeline.

verse.text: Wisdom is a shelter as money is a shelter, but the advantage of knowledge is this: Wisdom preserves those who have it.
verse.reflection: Reflection: New technology always outruns our wisdom about how to use it well. This verse is a quiet nudge to ask not just 'can we?' but 'should we, and how carefully?'

articles.headline: Hiring Steadies After Two Volatile Quarters
articles.summary: New jobs data shows hiring leveling off across manufacturing and services, easing fears of a sharper slowdown while wage growth continues to moderate.

articles.headline: Small Business Loan Applications Tick Upward
articles.summary: Community banks report a modest rise in small business loan applications this quarter, a signal some economists read as cautious optimism heading into fall.

verse.text: Trust in the LORD with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding; in all your ways submit to him, and he will make your paths straight.
verse.reflection: Reflection: Markets rise and steady and dip again — that's just what they do. This verse points to something sturdier than a quarterly report to build your trust on.

articles.headline: Study Links Consistent Sleep Schedules to Lower Heart Risk
articles.summary: A decade-long study of over 70,000 adults found that consistent sleep and wake times were more strongly linked to heart health than total hours slept.

articles.headline: Community Health Clinics Expand Telehealth Access
articles.summary: Federally funded clinics are rolling out expanded video-visit options for rural patients, aiming to close gaps in specialist access outside major cities.

verse.text: So do not fear, for I am with you; do not be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you and help you.
verse.reflection: Reflection: Health news can stir up worry fast, whether it's about our own bodies or the systems meant to care for them. This verse offers strength that doesn't depend on a diagnosis.

closingBlessing: Whatever today holds, go into it steady — you've already been reminded who's holding it. — Numbers 6:24-26
